work.title: 二重影
work.description: A dark historical fantasy visual novel set in the 17th year of Kan'ei (1640), following a cursed samurai with two shadows who travels to an isolated island steeped in twin sacrificial rituals.

work.title: インタールード
work.description: A psychological mystery visual novel featuring dynamic parallax scenes and a branching timeline following an ordinary student whose everyday world begins unraveling after encounter with a mysterious girl.
